display.purpose: Hero headlines and first-view brand promises only.

headline.purpose: Section titles and major trust-building statements.

title.purpose: Service titles, compact marketing panels, and card headings.

body.purpose: Readable marketing copy, forms, and supporting details.

label.purpose: Short section kickers and compact categorical marks.

brandGlow.purpose: Primary CTAs and icon marks on dark brand surfaces.

header.purpose: Transparent to locked dark header state.

componentNotes.buttons: Rounded-lg practical rectangles. Primary actions use M5 Blue or the brand blue gradient with visible focus rings.
componentNotes.cards: Use cards for actual repeated items, forms, and panels. Avoid turning every section into a card.
componentNotes.inputs: Public contact inputs should be 44px tall, rounded-lg, and focus with electric-blue ring.
componentNotes.navigation: Transparent over hero, then locked Shop Black after scroll. Mobile menu is a dark panel with direct phone action.
componentNotes.paintMarks: Brush strokes, roller edges, drips, texture, and electric glows are signature brand marks. Use for meaning and rhythm.

dos: Lead with real work, real badges, real reviews, and clear contact actions.
Use the committed blue system as paint-like material.
Keep CTA text direct and local.
Preserve WCAG AA contrast and reduced-motion support.
donts: Do not use generic contractor website templates.
Do not use cold corporate SaaS aesthetics.
Do not make the site overly minimalist and empty.
Do not create busy small-business clutter.
Do not make M5 Painting look like a Silicon Valley startup.
Do not use thick colored side-stripe borders.
